description: Additional data for the paper \"Higher-Order Recursive Linearization of Non-linear DAE Power System Models\ is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Marcos Alfredo Hernández-Ortega, Arturo Román-Messina. "An extensive class of dynamical systems can be naturally modeled using differential-algebraic equations (DAEs), including robotic mechanisms, vehicle dynamics, electrical circuits, and electric power systems with converter-interfaced renewable energy sources (RES). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
